source_refs.note: 4- Data Analysis: a main subheading of 22.1.1 Components of Biostatistics, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 187-187.

blocks.text: Data ka khulasa karne, use bayan karne aur us se nateeja nikalne (inference) ke liye statistical techniques lagana. Descriptive statistics data ki khasiyatein batati hain (mean, median, mode, standard deviation waghera). Inferential statistics, jaise hypothesis testing, regression analysis aur modelling, sample data se poori population ke baare mein nataij nikalne deti hain.
